[[File:2026 Retro League Prelude P-ANH Precon DS GEMP.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The deck in the [[GEMP]] deck builder. Screenshot: [[Brandon Price]].<ref name="t86180" />]]
This is the pre-constructed Dark Side deck that every player used in the Prelude of the [[2026 Retro League]], an event for new and returning players held 11–30 January 2026.<ref name="bisco20261019">Bill Bisco, personal communication, 19 October 2026.</ref><ref name="t86346">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86346 2026 SWCCG Online Retro League (& Cumulative Standings)], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164534/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86346.html Internet Archive].</ref> [[Brandon Price]] built it and its Light Side partner as learning decks for [[Premiere - A New Hope]], aiming for balanced, interactive games that show common early cards and mechanics. He changed the lists after a discussion with [[Charles Hickey]].<ref name="t86180">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86180 NARP friendly P-ANH PreCon decks], forum.starwarsccg.org (final decks posted 25 January 2026). Snapshot: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86180.html swccg.com]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261019195202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86180.html Internet Archive, 19 October 2026].</ref>
